notes: Huey is a static browser app with no build step (src/ is the app). .ui-capture/build.sh copies src/ to .ui-capture/out, vendors the CDN dependencies, generates the seed data (seed/generate-data.mjs writes the CSVs; seed/generate-duckdb.mjs builds northwind_dw.duckdb with @duckdb/node-api 2.0.0, the same DuckDB version as the WASM build) and patches out/index.html (patch-index.mjs). Tools are pinned in mise.toml (node 22.12.0); npm versions are pinned in vendor/package.json. The persona is an analyst at 'Northwind Outdoor Co.', an outdoor gear retailer. Datasources tab: the DuckDB database northwind_dw, with schemas sales (order_lines, dim_customer [640], dim_product [50], product_reviews [420, short and long text, mixed moderation status], views v_monthly_revenue and v_returns), ops (support_tickets, inventory_snapshot, dim_store, store_daily_traffic [~3.9k days]) and marketing (campaign_spend, view v_roas). Files: northwind_order_lines_2023-2025.csv (~12k order lines from Jan 2023 to 14 Nov 2025; statuses Delivered/Shipped/Processing/Cancelled/Returned/Refunded/Lost in Transit; channels, regions, countries, cities including some missing or upper-cased ones; promo codes), support_tickets_2024-2025.csv (~4.1k tickets with open, in-progress, escalated and closed statuses, agents and CSAT), marketing_spend_by_campaign.csv (~2.4k rows) and inventory_snapshot_2025-11-14.csv (200 rows). Catalogs Manager: 4 saved catalogs (duckdb, ducklake, iceberg, sqlite). Secrets Manager: 3 secrets (s3, iceberg, huggingface). On load the app opens the default report: net revenue (sum of net_amount) by category/subcategory against year/quarter of order_timestamp, filtered on status, with the Attributes sidebar pinned. Main areas: the top toolbar (upload, load from URL, attach remote catalog, clone session, autorun, Quick Query, current datasource, download, secrets, settings, about), the sidebar with Datasources and Attributes tabs (derived date fields, statistics), the query editor (Filters/Columns/Rows/Cells axes) and the pivot table. DuckDB-WASM boots in a web worker, so the seeded report appears a few seconds after page load; html[data-huey-seeded=true] marks completion. Deep links (#<base64 route>) also work and are applied after the files load. The PWA service worker in out/ is patched to precache its app shell relative to its own location, because out/ is the web root rather than the repo root; all 113 entries exist, so precaching makes no 404s. To test locally: PORT=5463 node .ui-capture/serve.mjs .ui-capture/out (a strict server: missing files with an extension return 404).
